question: What ritual structure should be created outside that area for subsequent worship?
premises: An area outside the previous seat is specified.
An eight-petalled form is to be made.
Worship is to be performed at the petal bases.
inference: Outside that, one should make an eight-petalled lotus and worship at the bases of the petals.
plain_english: Outside that, having made an eight-petalled lotus, one should worship at the bases of the petals.
